A.claim: A^3 + B^3 = C^p has no primitive nontrivial solutions for every prime p, not merely for p <= 700.

B.claim: Unified: if 3 | gcd(x,y,z) or 4 | gcd(x,y,z), then A^x + B^y = C^z has no positive solutions. Packages the 3|x,3|y,3|z family (FLT3) and the 4|x,4|y,z even family (not_fermat_42).

combine.instructions: Would combining these two candidates produce a genuinely NEW attack (not a reword of either)?
criteria: level 2: a concrete new lemma or test could be written
level 3: the combination could close an infinite family
